scientific_scope: 酸/HFIP 条件下两类底物的 trans 成环机制、局部活化差别和配平净反应驱动。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 烯酸从题定反应组分经亲电并入/分子内捕获到产物的相连剖面实际能量及适用活化估计；需组成/质子账本，不要求所有TS均精细确认。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed connected profile energies and applicable activation estimates for acid electrophilic incorporation and intramolecular capture to the given product, with component/proton bookkeeping; detailed saddle validation is a separate result.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 酸类形成路线的局部 Gibbs 势垒及其匹配前体/反应态能量。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed local Gibbs activation energy and matched precursor/reactive-state energies for the acid-derived formation route.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 磺酰胺从题定反应组分经亲电并入/分子内捕获到产物的相连剖面实际能量及适用活化估计；需组成/质子账本，不要求所有TS均精细确认。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed connected profile energies and applicable activation estimates for sulfonamide electrophilic incorporation and intramolecular capture to the given product, with component/proton bookkeeping; detailed saddle validation is a separate result.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 磺酰胺形成路线的局部 Gibbs 势垒及其匹配前体/反应态能量。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed local Gibbs activation energy and matched precursor/reactive-state energies for the sulfonamide-derived formation route.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 两底物对应捕获的实际活化自由能、前体和参照，及相应连接证据。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: 两底物对应捕获的实际活化自由能、前体和参照，及相应连接证据。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 两底物金刚烷基并入/耦合转化的实际活化量及匹配库存。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: 两底物金刚烷基并入/耦合转化的实际活化量及匹配库存。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 足以支撑主要形成需求比较的实际前体/活化能量与参照关系。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: 足以支撑主要形成需求比较的实际前体/活化能量与参照关系。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 酸类完整配平组分的 Gibbs 能量账本及净 ΔG。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed Gibbs energies for the complete balanced acid-reaction inventory and the resulting net ΔG.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 磺酰胺完整配平组分的 Gibbs 能量账本及净 ΔG。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed Gibbs energies for the complete balanced sulfonamide-reaction inventory and the resulting net ΔG.

verification_support: 正文 Scheme 7、SI Fig.S3/Table S21/S22；历史验证支持两条连接、磺酰胺较低局部活化需求及两类配平净反应均放能。 正文PDF第8–9页与SI S80图S3已重读；参考为协同亲电trans加成。局部TS与完整路线分项不等于认定任意局部扫描已证明参考全程。
boundaries: trans 产物已给，不按重画其结构计分；不加全部 cis/1,1/1,2 网络或精确产率。
两个净反应均须配平质子、离去组分及参考库存，不能用不配平产物总能。
293.15 K 是计算约定，不能称实验室温被精确报告为该值。
整体路线与局部TS化学各15；仅局部成环TS可独立通过后者。两底物活化比较须是化学对应的实际局部事件，不能拿不同过程任意相减。
source_locator: Main PDF pp.8–9, Scheme 7 and mechanistic discussion; supplementary_001 PDF/S pp.79–81, section 7.3, Fig.S3, Table S21 and the start of Table S22.
whole_case_success: All required_for_success outcomes must pass for whole-case success; each supported independent outcome retains its weighted points if other outcomes fail.
